payload.title: Still pictograms through the image-style slot
payload.description:
Replace the animated pictogram plates (publication/redesign/figures, video-motion) with still pictograms delivered by the brand pack's image-style slot; the animated code is not carried forward.
Scenario: A story shows a still pictogram
  Given an item with a pictogram assignment
  When its card and page render
  Then a still image of the correct size shows from the image-style slot and no animation code loads

Depends on: PPY-88a883, PPY-1f68bf.
